key_insight: Atomic MathReasoner improves mathematical reasoning by selecting problem-specific compositions of specialized atomic-skill LoRA experts.
engineering_relevance: A lightweight router enables adaptive expert composition at inference without costly online optimization.
method: Train capability-specific LoRA experts and discover low-loss composition prototypes through gradient-free optimization.
Score prototypes using reference-solution token-level negative log-likelihood and filter ambiguous assignments with a confidence margin.
Distill prototype assignments into a lightweight router that selects a composition for each problem.
evidence_signal: On AtomicMath with Qwen2.5-Math-Instruct-7B, average field accuracy rose from 64.4% to 68.1% at Level 1 and from 59.3% to 63.7% at Level 2; average logical reasoning performance rose from 39.4% to 46.8%.
watch_item: Generalization beyond AtomicMath and the computational cost of offline prototype discovery are not established in the abstract.
paper_title: Atomic MathReasoner: Instance-Level Composition of Atomic Reasoning Skills for Mathematical LLMs
